cases.plan_item: CDFW floor waste, endpoint-claim route (triage group R3; daily card D07 neighbour); BUG-1223 (the false refusal fixed in C-75; Tim's 29 Oct 2026 ruling: no floor waste on an inspection opening, the plain refusal stays); BUG-147 is related, not the same

cases.expected: CDFW with the point 51777.389,-46593.223 (inspection opening 108F55, on pipe ends) is refused with "IO1 is already at this point, and a new source cannot sit on top of it." and adds no FLOOR WASTE block and no text FW; it does not print "A nearby pipe's Civil record changed", "rolled back" or "more than one source". The drawing file on disk is unchanged.
cases.why_not_unit: The claim of a pipe end by a block runs against the real pits, pipes and tagged blocks of the live drawing.
not_automated: Batch 6 (28 Oct 2026, Codex cx_cr11 and cx_cr21): the old assertion log civil has "Landing index changed between preview and pick" is REMOVED (it required the symptom to stay and would have rejected a correct fix); the whole Civil log of the run is now only RECORDED. There is no U step: nothing is placed, because CE refuses.

BUG-1223 placement or justified-refusal intent, joined placement, repeat pick and the other three opening points must be proved before whole-bug acceptance (Tim ruled on 29 Oct 2026 that a floor waste is NOT allowed on an inspection opening and CE keeps its plain refusal, so this case asserts the refusal; the point-to-opening numbering (IO1 to IO4 in the order R36e, p2, p3, p4) is read from the c1a and c1b runs of 29 Oct on 3.0.85; the free-pipe-end placement half of BUG-1223 is covered by no case; no pipe-connection reader exists). The three other openings are R36e_p2, R36e_p3 and R36e_p4. CDSOURCE (named in BUG-147 and BUG-132) is not run. Which blocks carry the AGI tag is not read. The typed point is not a mouse pick: whether a real mouse pick at the same place behaves the same is not driven.
